summary: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT), Bhopal
intro: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT), Bhopal has released Advertisement No. Rectt/NT/2026/07 for 55 Group B and Group C non-teaching posts including Superintendent, Senior/Junior Assistant, Technical Assistant, Library & Information Assistant, Senior Technician and Technician.
The posts carry Pay Level 3 to 6 of the 7th CPC. Online applications are open till 10 December 2026. This recruitment also appeared in Employment News (28 Nov – 4 Dec 2026).
table: Separate fee for each post – see official notification

p: Educational qualification and experience differ for each post (graduation, diploma, ITI or 10+2 with technical qualification as applicable). Please read the post-wise eligibility in the official advertisement on manit.ac.in.

The upper age limit is post-wise (reported as about 27 years for Group C and 30–33 years for Group B posts) with relaxation for reserved categories as per Government of India rules. A separate application and fee is required for each post. Confirm exact age limits and fee in the official notice.

ul: Written test / skill test as per post

ol: Open Advertisement Rectt/NT/2026/07 and check post-wise eligibility.
Apply online separately for each post you want.
Pay the fee for each post and submit before 10 December 2026.
